Question for my crypto followers:

Is alt season extinct?

$Doge used to have incredible spikes every 240 days or so. The latest pattern was so disappointingly small, makes me wonder if the pattern is now gone.
Never take investment advice from someone who say they bought “shares” of $doge or $btc
